interface.longDescription:
Get a home insurance quote from Allianz Ireland on ChatGPT.
We use AI to help prepopulate your quote details, making it quicker and easier for you, and you’ll always have the opportunity to review and confirm everything before proceeding.
Describe your property and cover needs, and tailor your policy with optional benefits to suit you.
Download the plugin to get started!

Use of data
You are interacting with an Artificial Intelligence (AI) system developed to support the home insurance quotation process.
The AI assistant helps collect, interpret and structure the information you provide in order to support the generation of a home insurance quotation. While the AI is designed to assist with this process, it may occasionally misunderstand information provided or request clarification.
Please review the information collected during your interaction and ensure it is accurate before submitting it to Allianz.
The AI assistant does not make underwriting, eligibility, acceptance or final pricing decisions. Any quotation, pricing assessment or insurance decision is determined by Allianz systems and processes based on the information provided.
